metadata.case_name: GURUNG SANTOSH KUMAR v. PACIFIC CROWN ENGINEERING LTD AND OTHERS

injuries.description: a piece of metallic object about the size of 0.5 cm by 1 cm was found at the left interior part of his chest.
source: a piece of metallic object about the size of 0.5 cm by 1 cm was found at the left interior part of his chest.
On the same day, the Plaintiff had an operation to have that metallic object removed.
I therefore find that the Plaintiff did suffer an injury to his chest which healed completely
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the thorax

injuries.description: mild adjustment disorder with depressive symptom
source: I accept the opinion of Dr Chung that at the most the Plaintiff is suffering from a mild adjustment disorder with depression
I therefore find that ... his psychiatric condition was that he had a mild adjustment disorder with depressive symptom.

manifestations.description: Depressive symptoms / adjustment disorder with depression

treatments_received: chest x-ray on arrival at Tuen Mun Hospital
operation to remove metallic object (same day as admission)
follow-up reviews at Pok Oi Hospital, Tuen Mun Hospital, Yuen Long Jockey Club Clinic (for 45 times) and Yuen Long Government Out-patient Clinic
physiotherapy referral in 2004 (did not finish course due to non-compliance)
treatments_future: psychological counselling 4 sessions (as conceded by defence, at $2,500 x 4 sessions = $10,000)

losses.description: minor chest injury from a metallic foreign body which required operative removal and subsequently healed completely
mild adjustment disorder with depressive symptom affecting memory and causing disturbed sleep and anxiety

I accept the opinion of Dr Chung that at the most the Plaintiff is suffering from a mild adjustment disorder with depression I therefore find that ... his psychiatric condition was that he had a mild adjustment disorder with depressive symptom.
